name: BACH_0164_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged Tier 1 surgical frozen section with full model consensus, despite simulated severity-3 blur and focal high-risk regions.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%; Invasive, InSitu, Normal 0% [F1] | Calibrated score strongly favors benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at α=10% (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 1% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged despite blur; error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (79%–88% similarity) [F5] | All neighbors benign; nearest InSitu 76% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.56, contribution -1.00) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score (-0.27, contribution +0.72) pushes toward invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (+1.76, contribution -0.69) favors benign glands [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (z=-0.94, contribution +0.66); unreliable 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical standardized score (z=-0.58, contribution +0.38) slightly raises risk · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur masks atypia in high-risk regions 6 (74%) and 1 (68%), matching InSitu contrast case BACH_0263 (76% similarity).
- Clear margin call [F7] misses involvement where superior (98%) and inferior/medial (92%) segments fall below the 100% threshold.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 1**: Highest heatmap risk (74%, 68%); inspect through severity-3 blur for occult atypia or invasion.
2. **Regions 2, 8**: Inspect superior (98%) and inferior/medial (92%) margin segments (x=1280, y=0; x=0, y=1280) for involvement.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 9**: Confirm benign tubule architecture and absent stromal invasion visually, since cell segmentation is disabled.
